                            const base = pid === '010D' ? 65 : pid === '0105' ? 85 : 1500;
                            const value = +(base + Math.random() * base * 0.15).toFixed(1);
                            setPreviewFormValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: value }));
                            updateComponentProps(compId, { lastValue: value });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'DataReceived', { value, pid });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'ON_CHANGE', { value, pid });
                            automationEngine.trigger('OBD2_TRIGGER', { pid, value, unit: pid === '010C' ? 'rpm' : pid === '010D' ? 'km/h' : '' });
                            return value;
                        }
                        obd2Service.queryPID(pid).then(result => {
                            if (!result) return;
                            setPreviewFormValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: result.value }));
                            updateComponentProps(compId, { lastValue: result.value });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'DataReceived', { value: result.value, unit: result.unit, pid });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'ON_CHANGE', { value: result.value, unit: result.unit, pid });
                            automationEngine.trigger('OBD2_TRIGGER', { pid, value: result.value, unit: result.unit });
                        }).catch(err => console.warn('[OBD2] ReadPID error:', err));
                        return;
                    }

                    // ── Start live stream ─────────────────────────────────────
                    if (methodId === 'StartLiveStream') {
                        const pid = comp.props.pid || '010C';
                        const intervalMs = Number(args?.[0]) || 1000;

                        if (!obd2Service.connected) {
                            // Simulation fallback (builder/preview without device)
                            let ticks = 0;
                            const maxTicks = 30;
                            const timer = setInterval(() => {
                                ticks++;
                                const base = pid === '010D' ? 65 : pid === '0105' ? 85 : 1700;
                                const value = +(base + Math.random() * base * 0.15).toFixed(1);
                                setPreviewFormValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: value }));
                                updateComponentProps(compId, { lastValue: value });
                                onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'DataReceived', { value, pid });
                                onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'ON_CHANGE', { value, pid });
                                automationEngine.trigger('OBD2_TRIGGER', { pid, value, unit: pid === '010C' ? 'rpm' : pid === '010D' ? 'km/h' : '' });
                                if (ticks >= maxTicks) clearInterval(timer);
                            }, Math.max(250, intervalMs));
                            return;
                        }

                        obd2Service.startLiveStream(compId, pid, intervalMs, (result) => {
                            if (!result) return;
                            setPreviewFormValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: result.value }));
                            updateComponentProps(compId, { lastValue: result.value });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'DataReceived', { value: result.value, unit: result.unit, pid });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'ON_CHANGE', { value: result.value, unit: result.unit, pid });
                            automationEngine.trigger('OBD2_TRIGGER', { pid, value: result.value, unit: result.unit });
                        });
                        return;
                    }

                    // ── Stop live stream ──────────────────────────────────────
                    if (methodId === 'StopLiveStream') {
                        obd2Service.stopLiveStream(compId);
                        return;
                    }

                    // ── Read DTC codes ─────────────────────────────────────────
                    if (methodId === 'ReadDTC') {
                        if (!obd2Service.connected) return;
                        obd2Service.readDTC().then(dtcs => {
                            const value = JSON.stringify(dtcs);
                            updateComponentProps(compId, { lastValue: value });
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'DataReceived', { value, dtcs, pid: 'DTC' });
                        }).catch(err => console.warn('[OBD2] ReadDTC error:', err));
                        return;
                    }

                    // ── Clear DTC codes ────────────────────────────────────────
                    if (methodId === 'ClearDTC') {
                        if (!obd2Service.connected) return;
                        obd2Service.clearDTC().then(ok => {
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, ok ? 'DTCCleared' : 'ClearDTCFailed');
                        }).catch(err => console.warn('[OBD2] ClearDTC error:', err));
                        return;
                    }

                    // ── Send raw AT command ────────────────────────────────────
                    if (methodId === 'SendAT') {
                        const atCmd = args?.[0];
                        if (!atCmd || !obd2Service.connected) return;
                        obd2Service.sendAT(String(atCmd)).then(raw => {
                            onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'ATResponse', { raw, cmd: atCmd });
                        }).catch(err => console.warn('[OBD2] SendAT error:', err));
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'PEDOMETER') {
                    if (['Start', 'Stop', 'Reset', 'Save'].includes(methodId)) return; // Stub
                }

                // --- Drawing and Animation Methods ---
                if (comp?.type === 'CANVAS') {
                    if (methodId === 'Clear') {
                        setCanvasDrawings(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: [] }));
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'DrawLine') {
                        const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = args;
                        setCanvasDrawings(prev => ({
                            ...prev,
                            [compId]: [...(prev[compId] || []), { type: 'line', x1, y1, x2, y2, color: comp.props.paintColor || '#000000', width: comp.props.lineWidth || 2 }]
                        }));
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'DrawCircle') {
                        const [centerX, centerY, radius, fill] = args;
                        setCanvasDrawings(prev => ({
                            ...prev,
                            [compId]: [...(prev[compId] || []), { type: 'circle', x: centerX, y: centerY, r: radius, fill, color: comp.props.paintColor || '#000000' }]
                        }));
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'BALL' || comp?.type === 'IMAGE_SPRITE') {
                    if (methodId === 'MoveTo') {
                        const [x, y] = args;
                        updateComponentProps(compId, { x, y });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'Bounce') {
                        const [edge] = args;
                        let heading = comp.props.heading || 0;
                        // MIT Edge Map: 1:north, 2:northeast, 3:east, 4:southeast, -1:south, -2:southwest, -3:west, -4:northwest
                        // Simple 4-way bounce for now
                        if (edge === 1 || edge === -1) heading = (360 - heading) % 360; // Top/Bottom
                        if (edge === 3 || edge === -3) heading = (180 - heading + 360) % 360; // Left/Right
                        updateComponentProps(compId, { heading });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'PointTowards') {
                        const [targetId] = args;
                        const target = (currentStepId === 'BASE' ? baseComponents : currentStep.components).find(c => c.id === targetId);
                        if (target) {
                            const dx = target.x - comp.x;
                            const dy = target.y - comp.y;
                            const heading = Math.atan2(-dy, dx) * (180 / Math.PI);
                            updateComponentProps(compId, { heading: (heading + 360) % 360 });
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'LOCATION_SENSOR') {
                    if (methodId === 'Geocode') {
                        const [address] = args;
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotLocationFromAddress', { address, latitude: '0.000', longitude: '0.000' });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'ReverseGeocode') {
                        const [lat, lon] = args;
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotAddress', { address: 'Mock location street' });
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'CLOCK') {
                    const now = new Date();
                    try {
                        switch (methodId) {
                            case 'AddDays': return new Date(args[0]).setDate(new Date(args[0]).getDate() + args[1]);
                            case 'AddHours': return new Date(args[0]).setHours(new Date(args[0]).getHours() + args[1]);
                            case 'AddMinutes': return new Date(args[0]).setMinutes(new Date(args[0]).getMinutes() + args[1]);
                            case 'AddMonths': return new Date(args[0]).setMonth(new Date(args[0]).getMonth() + args[1]);
                            case 'AddSeconds': return new Date(args[0]).setSeconds(new Date(args[0]).getSeconds() + args[1]);
                            case 'AddWeeks': return new Date(args[0]).setDate(new Date(args[0]).getDate() + (args[1] * 7));
                            case 'AddYears': return new Date(args[0]).setFullYear(new Date(args[0]).getFullYear() + args[1]);
                            case 'DayOfMonth': return new Date(args[0]).getDate();
                            case 'Duration': return new Date(args[1]) - new Date(args[0]);
                            case 'DurationToDays': return args[0] / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
                            case 'DurationToHours': return args[0] / (1000 * 60 * 60);
                            case 'DurationToMinutes': return args[0] / (1000 * 60);
                            case 'DurationToSeconds': return args[0] / 1000;
                            case 'DurationToWeeks': return args[0] / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 7);
                            case 'FormatDate': return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(args[0]));
                            case 'FormatDateTime': return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric', hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', second: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(args[0]));
                            case 'FormatTime': return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { hour: 'numeric', minute: 'numeric', second: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(args[0]));
                            case 'GetMillis': return new Date(args[0]).getTime();
                            case 'Hour': return new Date(args[0]).getHours();
                            case 'MakeDate': return new Date(args[0], args[1] - 1, args[2]).getTime();
                            case 'MakeInstant': return new Date(args[0] || Date.now()).getTime();
                            case 'MakeInstantFromMillis': return new Date(args[0]).getTime();
                            case 'MakeInstantFromParts': return new Date(args[0], args[1] - 1, args[2], args[3] || 0, args[4] || 0, args[5] || 0).getTime();
                            case 'MakeTime': { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(args[0] || 0, args[1] || 0, args[2] || 0); return d.getTime(); }
                            case 'Minute': return new Date(args[0]).getMinutes();
                            case 'Month': return new Date(args[0]).getMonth() + 1;
                            case 'MonthName': return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'long' }).format(new Date(args[0]));
                            case 'Now': return now.getTime();
                            case 'Second': return new Date(args[0]).getSeconds();
                            case 'SystemTime': return now.getTime();
                            case 'Weekday': return new Date(args[0]).getDay() + 1;
                            case 'WeekdayName': return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { weekday: 'long' }).format(new Date(args[0]));
                            case 'Year': return new Date(args[0]).getFullYear();
                        }
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.error('Clock error', err);
                        return null;
                    }
                }
                // --- End Sensor Methods ---

                // --- Storage Methods ---
                if (comp?.type === 'CLOUD_DB') {
                    if (methodId === 'GetValue') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotValue', { tag: args[0], value: 'Mock CloudDB Value' });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'GetTagList') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'TagList', { value: ['mockTag1', 'mockTag2'] });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'RemoveFirstFromList') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FirstRemoved', { value: 'MockRemovedItem' });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'StoreValue' || methodId === 'AppendValueToList' || methodId === 'ClearTag') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'UpdateDone', { tag: args[0], operation: methodId });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'CloudConnected') return true;
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'DATA_FILE') {
                    if (methodId === 'ReadFile') return; // Stub
                }

                if (['FILE', 'FILE_STORAGE'].includes(comp?.type)) {
                    if (methodId === 'AppendToFile' || methodId === 'SaveFile') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'AfterFileSaved', { fileName: args[1] });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'ReadFrom') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotText', { text: 'Mock File Read Content' });
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'Exists' || methodId === 'IsDirectory') return false;
                    if (methodId === 'ListDirectory') return [];
                    if (methodId === 'MakeFullPath') return args[1] ? `/${args[0]}/${args[1]}` : `/${args[0]}`;
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'SPREADSHEET') {
                    if (methodId === 'AddColumn') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedAddColumn', { columnNumber: 1 });
                    if (methodId === 'AddRow') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedAddRow', { rowNumber: 1 });
                    if (methodId === 'AddSheet') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedAddSheet', { sheetName: args[0] });
                    if (methodId === 'ClearRange') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedClearRange', {});
                    if (methodId === 'DeleteSheet') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedDeleteSheet', { sheetName: args[0] });
                    if (methodId === 'RemoveColumn') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedRemoveColumn', {});
                    if (methodId === 'RemoveRow') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedRemoveRow', {});
                    if (methodId === 'WriteCell') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedWriteCell', {});
                    if (methodId === 'WriteColumn') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedWriteColumn', {});
                    if (methodId === 'WriteRange') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedWriteRange', {});
                    if (methodId === 'WriteRow') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'FinishedWriteRow', {});

                    if (methodId === 'GetCellReference') return `${String.fromCharCode(64 + (args[1] || 1))}${args[0] || 1}`;
                    if (methodId === 'GetRangeReference') return `${String.fromCharCode(64 + (args[1] || 1))}${args[0] || 1}:${String.fromCharCode(64 + (args[3] || 1))}${args[2] || 1}`;

                    if (methodId === 'ListSheets') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotSheetList', { sheetNames: ['Sheet1'] });
                    if (methodId === 'ReadCell') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotCellData', { cellData: 'MockCellData' });
                    if (methodId === 'ReadColumn') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotColumnData', { columnData: ['MockCol1', 'MockCol2'] });
                    if (methodId === 'ReadRange') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotRangeData', { rangeData: [['Mock1', 'Mock2']] });
                    if (methodId === 'ReadRow') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotRowData', { rowDataList: ['MockRow1'] });
                    if (methodId === 'ReadSheet') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotSheetData', { sheetData: [['Mock1']] });
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'TINY_DB') {
                    if (methodId === 'GetTags') return ['tag1', 'tag2'];
                    if (methodId === 'GetEntries') return { tag1: 'value1', tag2: 'value2' };
                    if (methodId === 'GetValue') return args[1]; // Return valueIfTagNotThere by default
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'TINY_WEB_DB') {
                    if (methodId === 'GetValue') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotValue', { tagFromWebDB: args[0], valueFromWebDB: 'Mock WebDB Value' });
                    if (methodId === 'StoreValue') onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'ValueStored', {});
                }
                // --- End Storage Methods ---

                // --- Map Methods ---
                if (comp?.type === 'MAP') {
                    if (methodId === 'PanTo') {
                        // Mock pan
                        return;
                    }
                    if (methodId === 'Save') return 'mock/path/map.geojson';
                }

                if (['MARKER', 'CIRCLE', 'POLYGON', 'RECTANGLE', 'LINE_STRING'].includes(comp?.type)) {
                    if (methodId === 'DistanceToFeature' || methodId === 'DistanceToPoint') return 100.5; // Mock distance
                    if (methodId === 'BearingToFeature' || methodId === 'BearingToPoint') return 45.0; // Mock bearing
                    if (methodId === 'SetLocation' || methodId === 'HideInfobox' || methodId === 'ShowInfobox') return;
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'NAVIGATION') {
                    if (methodId === 'RequestDirections') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'GotDirections', {
                            directions: ['Head North', 'Turn Left'],
                            points: [[0, 0], [1, 1]],
                            distance: 1200,
                            duration: 300
                        });
                        return;
                    }
                }
                // --- End Map Methods ---

                // --- Chart Methods ---
                if (comp?.type === 'CHART') {
                    if (methodId === 'ResetAxes') return;
                    if (methodId === 'SetDomain' || methodId === 'SetRange') return;
                    if (methodId === 'ExtendDomainToInclude' || methodId === 'ExtendRangeToInclude') return;
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'CHART_DATA_2D') {
                    if (methodId === 'AddEntry') return;
                    if (methodId === 'Clear') return;
                    if (methodId === 'RemoveEntry') return;
                    if (methodId === 'DoesEntryExist') return false;
                    if (methodId === 'GetAllEntries') return [[0, 0]];
                    if (methodId.startsWith('ImportFrom')) {
                        // Mock data injection
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'EntryClick', { x: 10, y: 25 });
                        return;
                    }
                }

                if (comp?.type === 'TRENDLINE') {
                    if (methodId === 'DisconnectFromChartData') return;
                    if (methodId === 'GetResultValue') return 0.95; // Mock R²
                }
                // --- End Chart Methods ---

                if (comp?.type === 'DATETIME_PICKER') {
                    if (methodId === 'LaunchPicker') {
                        const input = document.getElementById(`tp-input-${compId}`);
                        if (input) {
                            if (typeof input.showPicker === 'function') input.showPicker();
                            else input.click();
                        }
                    } else if (methodId === 'SetTimeToDisplay') {
                        const [hour, minute] = args;
                        const timeStr = `${String(hour).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minute).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                        setPreviewFormValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: timeStr }));
                    } else if (methodId === 'SetTimeToDisplayFromInstant') {
                        const [instant] = args;
                        try {
                            const dateObj = new Date(instant);
                            const timeStr = `${String(dateObj.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(dateObj.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
                            setPreviewFormValues(prev => ({ ...prev, [compId]: timeStr }));
                        } catch (e) {
                            console.error("Invalid instant format:", instant);
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (comp?.type === 'DROPDOWN') {
                    if (methodId === 'DisplayDropdown') {
                        const selectElement = document.getElementById(compId);
                        if (selectElement) {
                            selectElement.focus();
                            if (typeof selectElement.showPicker === 'function') {
                                selectElement.showPicker();
                            } else {
                                selectElement.click();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (comp?.type === 'LIST_PICKER') {
                    if (methodId === 'Open' || methodId === 'LaunchPicker') {
                        onWidgetInteraction(comp, 'BeforePicking');
                        setActiveListPicker({
                            compId: comp.id,
                            searchQuery: '',
                            elements: comp.props.elements || comp.props.options || [],
                            title: comp.props.title || 'Select Item',
                            itemBg: comp.props.itemBackgroundColor,
                            itemText: comp.props.itemTextColor,
                            showFilterBar: comp.props.showFilterBar
                        });
                    }
                }
                if (comp?.type === 'NOTIFIER') {
                    if (methodId === 'ShowAlert') {
                        const [notice] = args;
                        setNotifierState({
                            isOpen: true, type: 'ALERT', message: notice,
                            compId: comp.id, bgColor: comp.props.backgroundColor, textColor: comp.props.textColor
                        });
                        setTimeout(() => setNotifierState(prev => prev.type === 'ALERT' ? { ...prev, isOpen: false } : prev),
                            comp.props.notifierLength === 1 ? 3500 : 1500);
                    } else if (methodId === 'ShowMessageDialog') {
                        const [message, title, buttonText] = args;
                        setNotifierState({
                            isOpen: true, type: 'MESSAGE', message, title, button1Text: buttonText || 'OK', compId: comp.id
                        });
                    } else if (methodId === 'ShowChooseDialog') {
                        const [message, title, b1, b2, cancelable] = args;
                        setNotifierState({
                            isOpen: true, type: 'CHOOSE', message, title, button1Text: b1, button2Text: b2, cancelable, compId: comp.id
                        });
                    } else if (methodId === 'ShowTextDialog' || methodId === 'ShowPasswordDialog') {
                        const [message, title, cancelable] = args;
                        setNotifierState({
                            isOpen: true, type: methodId === 'ShowTextDialog' ? 'TEXT' : 'PASSWORD',
                            message, title, cancelable, textInput: '', compId: comp.id
                        });
                    } else if (methodId === 'ShowProgressDialog') {
                        const [message, title] = args;
                        setNotifierState({
                            isOpen: true, type: 'PROGRESS', message, title, compId: comp.id
                        });
                    } else if (methodId === 'DismissProgressDialog') {
                        setNotifierState(prev => prev.type === 'PROGRESS' ? { ...prev, isOpen: false } : prev);
                    } else if (methodId === 'LogInfo') {
                        console.info(`[Notifier Log] ${args[0]}`);
                    } else if (methodId === 'LogWarning') {
                        console.warn(`[Notifier Log] ${args[0]}`);
                    } else if (methodId === 'LogError') {
                        console.error(`[Notifier Log] ${args[0]}`);
                    }
                }
                if (comp?.type === 'PASSWORD_TEXT' || comp?.type === 'TEXT_INPUT' || comp?.type === 'TEXT_AREA') {
                    const input = document.getElementById(`input-${compId}`);
                    if (input) {
                        if (methodId === 'RequestFocus') {
                            input.focus();
                        } else if (methodId === 'MoveCursorToStart') {
                            input.setSelectionRange(0, 0);
                            input.focus();
                        } else if (methodId === 'MoveCursorToEnd') {
                            const len = input.value.length;
                            input.setSelectionRange(len, len);
                            input.focus();
                        } else if (methodId === 'MoveCursorTo') {
                            const pos = Math.max(0, (Number(args[0]) || 1) - 1);
                            input.setSelectionRange(pos, pos);
                            input.focus();
                        } else if (methodId === 'HideKeyboard') {
                            input.blur();
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (comp?.type === 'EMBED_WEB') {
                    const iframeEl = document.getElementById(`webview-iframe-${compId}`);
                    if (methodId === 'GoToUrl') {
                        const [url] = args;
                        updateComponentProps(compId, { url, currentUrl: url });
                        if (iframeEl) iframeEl.src = url;
                    } else if (methodId === 'GoHome') {
                        const homeUrl = comp.props.homeUrl || comp.props.url;
                        updateComponentProps(compId, { url: homeUrl, currentUrl: homeUrl });
                        if (iframeEl) iframeEl.src = homeUrl;
                    } else if (methodId === 'GoBack') {
                        try { iframeEl?.contentWindow?.history?.back(); } catch (e) { }
                    } else if (methodId === 'GoForward') {
                        try { iframeEl?.contentWindow?.history?.forward(); } catch (e) { }
                    } else if (methodId === 'Reload') {
                        try { iframeEl?.contentWindow?.location?.reload(); } catch (e) {
                            // Cross-origin – remount
                            const src = iframeEl?.src;
                            if (src) { iframeEl.src = ''; setTimeout(() => { iframeEl.src = src; }, 50); }
                        }
                    } else if (methodId === 'RunJavaScript') {
                        const [js] = args;
                        try { iframeEl?.contentWindow?.eval(js); } catch (e) { console.warn('[WebViewer] RunJavaScript cross-origin blocked:', e); }
                    } else if (methodId === 'StopLoading') {
                        try { iframeEl?.contentWindow?.stop?.(); } catch (e) { }
                    } else if (methodId === 'ClearCaches' || methodId === 'ClearCookies' || methodId === 'ClearLocations') {
                        console.log(`[WebViewer] ${methodId} – browser-level cache/cookie clearing is not available in web runtime.`);
                    } else if (methodId === 'CanGoBack') {
                        try { return iframeEl?.contentWindow?.history?.length > 1; } catch (e) { return false; }
                    } else if (methodId === 'CanGoForward') {
                        try { return iframeEl?.contentWindow?.history?.length > 1; } catch (e) { return false; }
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        const runMatchingBlocks = (codeStr, sourceId = 'Global/Screen') => {
            if (!codeStr) return;
            const lines = codeStr.split('\n');
            let capturing = false;
            let capturedCode = '';

            for (const line of lines) {
                if (line.startsWith(`// TRIGGER: ${triggerKey}`)) {
                    capturing = true;
                    continue;
                }
                if (capturing) {
                    if (line.startsWith('// TRIGGER:')) {
                        break; // Hit another trigger
                    }
                    capturedCode += line + '\n';
                }
            }

            if (capturedCode) {
                console.log(`[Blockly Runtime] Executing captured code for ${triggerKey} (from ${sourceId}):`, capturedCode);
                try {
                    // Reset tracer before run
                    runtimeContext._currentBlockId = null;
                    // Use AsyncFunction so Blockly generated `await` statements do not throw syntax errors
                    const AsyncFunction = Object.getPrototypeOf(async function () { }).constructor;
                    const run = new AsyncFunction('context', capturedCode);
                    run(runtimeContext).catch(e => {
                        console.error(`[Blockly Runtime] Async Execution Error (${sourceId}):`, e);
                        if (runtimeContext._currentBlockId) {
                            setBlocklyRuntimeError({
                                blockId: runtimeContext._currentBlockId,
                                message: e.message || "Runtime Exception"
                            });
                        }
                    });
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error(`[Blockly Runtime] Setup/Parse Error (${sourceId}):`, e);
                    if (runtimeContext._currentBlockId) {
                        setBlocklyRuntimeError({
                            blockId: runtimeContext._currentBlockId,
                            message: e.message || "Parser Error"
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        };

        // 1. Run Global Logic
        runMatchingBlocks(globalLogicCode, 'Global');

        // 2. Run Screen Logic
        runMatchingBlocks(stepLogic, 'Screen');

        // 3. Run Scoped Widget Logic for all components on screen
        if (currentStep?.components) {
            currentStep.components.forEach(comp => {
                if (comp.logic?.code) {
                    runMatchingBlocks(comp.logic.code, `Widget:${comp.name || comp.id}`);
                }
            });
        }

        // 4. Run Scoped Widget Logic for base components
        if (baseComponents) {
            baseComponents.forEach(comp => {
                if (comp.logic?.code) {
                    runMatchingBlocks(comp.logic.code, `BaseWidget:${comp.name || comp.id}`);
                }
            });
        }
    };

    const handleUpdateWidgetLogic = async (compId, xml, code) => {
        if (!compId) return;
        const nextSteps = steps.map(s => ({
            ...s,
            components: (s.components || []).map(c => c.id === compId ? { ...c, logic: { xml, code } } : c)
        }));
        const nextBase = baseComponents.map(c => c.id === compId ? { ...c, logic: { xml, code } } : c);

        setSteps(nextSteps);
        setBaseComponents(nextBase);

        // Persistent save
        await handleSave(true, { steps: nextSteps, baseComponents: nextBase });
    };

    const onWidgetInteraction = (comp, eventId, payload = {}) => {
        if (viewMode !== 'PREVIEW' || !comp || !comp.props) return;

        console.log(`[Runtime] Interaction with ${comp.id} (${comp.type}) - Event: ${eventId}`, payload);

        // 1. Execute Blockly Logic (Granular Event)
        executeBlocklyLogic(`WIDGET_EVENT:${comp.id}:${eventId}`, payload);

        // Handle Action property (e.g. for Mavi Template buttons)
        if (eventId === 'ON_CLICK' && comp.props.action) {
            enqueueTriggerEvent({
                eventId,
                triggers: [{
                    name: `${comp.id} action`,
                    enabled: true,
                    stopOnError: false,
                    clauses: [{
                        id: `auto_${Date.now()}`,
                        match: 'ALL',
                        conditions: [],
                        actions: [{ type: comp.props.action, payload: { stepId: comp.props.targetStepId } }]
                    }]
                }],
                stopOnErrorDefault: false
            });
        }

        // Handle formal Triggers
        if (comp.props.triggers) {
            const widgetTriggers = comp.props.triggers
                .filter(t => t.event === eventId || (!t.event && (['BUTTON', 'COMPLETE_BUTTON', 'MENU', 'OBD2_CLEAR_DTC'].includes(comp.type) ? eventId === 'ON_CLICK' : eventId === 'ON_CHANGE')))
                .map(t => ({
                    ...t,
                    stopOnError: typeof t.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? t.stopOnError : false
                }));
            enqueueTriggerEvent({
                eventId,
                triggers: widgetTriggers,
                stopOnErrorDefault: false
            });
        }

        // Step-level machine/device trigger
        if (DEVICE_TRIGGER_COMPONENT_TYPES.includes(comp.type) && ['ON_CHANGE', 'ON_CLICK'].includes(eventId)) {
            // 1. Blockly Logic (Station-level Device Trigger)
            executeBlocklyLogic(`DEVICE_OUTPUT:${comp.type}:CURRENT`, payload);
            executeBlocklyLogic(`DEVICE_OUTPUT:${comp.type}:ALL`, payload);

            // 2. Original Trigger Engine
            const activeStep = steps.find(s => s.id === currentStepId);
            if (activeStep?.triggers) {
                const deviceTriggers = activeStep.triggers
                    .filter(t => t.event === 'ON_DEVICE_INPUT')
                    .map(t => ({
                        ...t,
                        stopOnError: typeof t.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? t.stopOnError : false
                    }));
                enqueueTriggerEvent({
                    eventId: 'ON_DEVICE_INPUT',
                    triggers: deviceTriggers,
                    stopOnErrorDefault: false
                });
            }
        }
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (viewMode !== 'PREVIEW') return;

        // Timing log for the previous step
        if (lastStepStartTime) {
            const duration = Math.round((Date.now() - lastStepStartTime) / 1000);
            const prevStepId = lastStepIdRef.current;
            setStepTimeLogs(prev => [...prev, { stepId: prevStepId, duration, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }]);
        }
        setLastStepStartTime(Date.now());

        // 1. Blockly Global Logic: ON_STEP_EXIT
        executeBlocklyLogic('ON_STEP_EXIT');

        // 2. Original Trigger Engine: ON_STEP_EXIT for the previous step
        const prevStep = steps.find(s => s.id === lastStepIdRef.current);
        if (prevStep && prevStep.triggers) {
            const exitTriggers = prevStep.triggers
                .filter(t => t.event === 'ON_STEP_EXIT')
                .map(t => ({
                    ...t,
                    stopOnError: typeof t.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? t.stopOnError : true
                }));
            enqueueTriggerEvent({
                eventId: 'ON_STEP_EXIT',
                triggers: exitTriggers,
                stopOnErrorDefault: true
            });
        }

        // 3. Blockly Global Logic: ON_STEP_ENTER
        executeBlocklyLogic('ON_STEP_ENTER');
        executeBlocklyLogic('ON_STEP_INITIALIZE'); // Aliased for MIT parity

        // 4. Original Trigger Engine: ON_STEP_ENTER for the new step
        const newStep = steps.find(s => s.id === currentStepId);
        if (newStep && newStep.triggers) {
            const enterTriggers = newStep.triggers
                .filter(t => t.event === 'ON_STEP_ENTER')
                .map(t => ({
                    ...t,
                    stopOnError: typeof t.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? t.stopOnError : true
                }));
            enqueueTriggerEvent({
                eventId: 'ON_STEP_ENTER',
                triggers: enterTriggers,
                stopOnErrorDefault: true
            });
        }

        lastStepIdRef.current = currentStepId;
    }, [currentStepId, viewMode]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (viewMode !== 'PREVIEW') return;

        const unsubscribe = automationEngine.addListener((eventType, eventData) => {
            if (eventType === 'TABLE_ROW_ADDED') {
                executeBlocklyLogic(`TABLE_EVENT:${eventData.tableId}:CREATED`, { record: eventData.record });
            } else if (eventType === 'TABLE_ROW_UPDATED') {
                executeBlocklyLogic(`TABLE_EVENT:${eventData.tableId}:UPDATED`, { record: eventData.updatedData });
            }
        });

        return unsubscribe;
    }, [viewMode]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (viewMode === 'PREVIEW') {
            // 1. Blockly Global Logic: ON_APP_START
            executeBlocklyLogic('ON_APP_START');

            // 2. Original Trigger Engine: ON_APP_START
            appTriggers
                .filter(t => t.event === 'ON_APP_START')
                .forEach((trig) => enqueueTriggerEvent({
                    eventId: 'ON_APP_START',
                    triggers: [{ ...trig, stopOnError: typeof trig.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? trig.stopOnError : true }],
                    stopOnErrorDefault: true
                }));
        }
    }, [viewMode]);

    // Timer logic for PREVIEW mode
    useEffect(() => {
        let interval = null;
        if (viewMode === 'PREVIEW') {
            interval = setInterval(() => {
                setPreviewTimer(prev => prev + 1);
            }, 1000);
        } else {
            setPreviewTimer(0);
        }
        return () => {
            if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
        };
    }, [viewMode]);

    // Background execution for TIMER triggers
    useEffect(() => {
        if (viewMode !== 'PREVIEW') return;

        const timerRefs = [];

        // App Triggers
        appTriggers.forEach((trig, idx) => {
            if (trig.event === 'TIMER' && trig.timerInterval > 0) {
                const interval = setInterval(() => {
                    console.log(`[Timer] Firing App trigger: ${trig.name}`);
                    enqueueTriggerEvent({
                        eventId: 'TIMER',
                        triggers: [{ ...trig, stopOnError: typeof trig.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? trig.stopOnError : false }],
                        stopOnErrorDefault: false
                    });
                }, trig.timerInterval * 1000);
                timerRefs.push(interval);
            }
        });

        // Step Triggers
        const activeStep = steps.find(s => s.id === currentStepId);
        if (activeStep && activeStep.triggers) {
            activeStep.triggers.forEach((trig, idx) => {
                if (trig.event === 'TIMER' && trig.timerInterval > 0) {
                    const interval = setInterval(() => {
                        console.log(`[Timer] Firing Step trigger: ${trig.name}`);
                        enqueueTriggerEvent({
                            eventId: 'TIMER',
                            triggers: [{ ...trig, stopOnError: typeof trig.stopOnError === 'boolean' ? trig.stopOnError : false }],
                            stopOnErrorDefault: false
                        });
                    }, trig.timerInterval * 1000);
                    timerRefs.push(interval);
                }
            });
        }

        return () => {
            timerRefs.forEach(clearInterval);
        };
    }, [viewMode, currentStepId, appTriggers, steps]);

    // Reset preview states when entering PREVIEW
    useEffect(() => {
        if (viewMode === 'PREVIEW') {
            setPreviewChecklistState({});
            setPreviewToggleState({});
            setPreviewQuantityLog({});
            setPreviewFormValues({});
            setPreviewMenuState({});
            setPreviewTimer(0);

            // Completion tracking init
            setAppExecutionId(`exec_${Date.now()}`);
            setAppStartTime(new Date().toISOString());
            setAppExecutorUser(appContext.user || 'OPERATOR01');
            setLastStepStartTime(Date.now());
            setStepTimeLogs([]);
            triggerQueueRef.current = [];
        } else {
            // Cleanup on exit
            setAppExecutionId(null);
            setAppStartTime(null);
            setAppExecutorUser(appContext.user || 'OPERATOR01');
            setLastStepStartTime(null);
            triggerQueueRef.current = [];
        }
    }, [viewMode]);

    useEffect(() => {
        loadApps();
        loadTables();
        loadIntegrations();
        if (currentAppId) {
            import('../utils/database').then(({ getCompletions }) => {
                getCompletions(currentAppId).then(setCompletions);
            });
        }
    }, [currentAppId]);

    // Refresh completions after a completion/cancel
    useEffect(() => {
        if (viewMode === 'PREVIEW' && currentAppId) {
            import('../utils/database').then(({ getCompletions }) => {
                getCompletions(currentAppId).then(setCompletions);
            });
        }
    }, [viewMode, currentAppId]);

    // IoT connection & listeners
    useEffect(() => {
        const unsubStatus = iotConnector.subscribeStatus(setIotStatus);
        const unsubMsg = iotConnector.subscribeMessage((msg) => {
            setIotStatus(prev => ({ ...prev, lastMessage: msg }));
        });
        return () => {
            unsubStatus();
            unsubMsg();
        };
    }, []);

    // Connect to broker when URL changes
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!iotConfig?.brokerUrl) return;
        iotConnector.connect(iotConfig.brokerUrl);
    }, [iotConfig?.brokerUrl]);

    // Subscribe to machine topics and store live data
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!iotConfig?.topics) return;
        const cleanups = iotConfig.topics.map(topicCfg => {
            const handler = (payload) => {
                setIotLiveData(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    [topicCfg.id]: { payload, topic: topicCfg.topic, ts: new Date().toISOString() }
                }));
            };
            iotConnector.subscribe(topicCfg.topic, handler);
            return () => iotConnector.unsubscribe(topicCfg.topic);
        });
        return () => cleanups.forEach(fn => fn());
    }, [iotConfig?.topics]);

    const loadApps = async () => {
        try {
            const data = await getAllFrontlineApps();

            if (!xmlStr || typeof xmlStr !== 'string') return xmlStr;

                const parser = new DOMParser();
                const xmlDoc = parser.parseFromString(xmlStr, "text/xml");
                const blocks = Array.from(xmlDoc.getElementsByTagName("block"));
                const toRemove = [];

                blocks.forEach(block => {
                    const type = block.getAttribute("type") || "";
                    // 1. Matches component-specific block types (events, methods, etc.)

                        toRemove.push(block);
                        return;

                    const hasWidgetRef = fields.some(f => f.getAttribute("name") === "WIDGET" && f.textContent === id);
                    if (hasWidgetRef) {
                        toRemove.push(block);
                    }
                });

                toRemove.forEach(b => b.parentNode && b.parentNode.removeChild(b));
                return new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(xmlDoc);

                return xmlStr;

        if (targetIds.length === 0) return;

        const updateArray = (arr) => {
            const newArr = [...arr];
            const selectedIndices = targetIds
                .map(id => newArr.findIndex(c => c.id === id))
                .filter(idx => idx !== -1)
                .sort((a, b) => a - b);

            if (selectedIndices.length === 0) return arr;

            switch (direction) {
                case 'FRONT': {
                    const selectedItems = selectedIndices.map(idx => newArr[idx]);
                    const remainingItems = newArr.filter((_, idx) => !selectedIndices.includes(idx));
                    return [...remainingItems, ...selectedItems];
                }
                case 'BACK': {
                    const selectedItems = selectedIndices.map(idx => newArr[idx]);
                    const remainingItems = newArr.filter((_, idx) => !selectedIndices.includes(idx));
                    return [...selectedItems, ...remainingItems];
                }
                case 'FORWARD': {
                    // Move each selected item one step forward (to the right/end)
                    for (let i = selectedIndices.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        const idx = selectedIndices[i];
                        if (idx < newArr.length - 1 && !selectedIndices.includes(idx + 1)) {
                            [newArr[idx], newArr[idx + 1]] = [newArr[idx + 1], newArr[idx]];
                        }
                    }
                    return newArr;
                }
                case 'BACKWARD': {
                    // Move each selected item one step backward (to the left/start)
                    for (let i = 0; i < selectedIndices.length; i++) {
                        const idx = selectedIndices[i];
                        if (idx > 0 && !selectedIndices.includes(idx - 1)) {
                            [newArr[idx], newArr[idx - 1]] = [newArr[idx - 1], newArr[idx]];
                        }
                    }
                    return newArr;
                }
                default:

            }

            return;

        if (confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this app? This action cannot be undone.')) {
            try {
                await deleteFrontlineApp(id);

                // Purge from all localStorage caches so LiveTerminal doesn't show ghost entries
                const cacheKeys = ['mavi_offline_vault', 'offline_apps_cache', 'draft_frontline_apps'];
                cacheKeys.forEach(key => {
                    try {
                        const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
                        if (raw) {
                            const arr = JSON.parse(raw);
                            if (Array.isArray(arr)) {
                                const filtered = arr.filter(a => String(a.id) !== String(id));
                                if (filtered.length !== arr.length) {
                                    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(filtered));
                                    console.log(`[Delete] Purged app ${id} from cache "${key}"`);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) { /* ignore parse errors */ }
                });

                // Remove from AppStore installed templates so template shows "Install" again
                try {
                    const raw = localStorage.getItem('installedAppStoreTemplates');
                    if (raw) {
                        const mapping = JSON.parse(raw);
                        const updatedMapping = {};
                        for (const [templateId, appId] of Object.entries(mapping)) {
                            if (String(appId) !== String(id)) {
                                updatedMapping[templateId] = appId;

                        }

                await loadApps();

                    let unique = name;
                    let counter = 1;
